frases.voz: Doctor, how do you know if your patient actually took their medication?
frases.sub: Doctor, how do you know if your patient actually took their medication?

frases.voz: According to the WHO, adherence in chronic diseases is only around fifty percent.
frases.sub: According to the WHO, adherence in chronic diseases is only around 50%.

frases.voz: With several medications and schedules, it's easy to forget.
frases.sub: With several medications and schedules, it's easy to forget.

frases.voz: Patients doubt whether they already took a dose, and in clinic, all you have is self-report.
frases.sub: Patients doubt whether they already took a dose, and in clinic, all you have is self-report.

frases.voz: Sometimes a dose is increased, when the real problem was adherence.
frases.sub: Sometimes a dose is increased, when the real problem was adherence.

frases.voz: That's why we built MediTrack: reminders on the watch, confirmation with evidence, and an alert to the caregiver.
frases.sub: That's why we built MediTrack: reminders on the watch, confirmation with evidence, and an alert to the caregiver.

frases.voz: It's eight o'clock. Rafael's watch vibrates: time for his metformin.
frases.sub: It's 8:00. Rafael's watch vibrates: time for his metformin.

frases.voz: As he takes it, the system gathers evidence: the hand-to-mouth gesture,
frases.sub: As he takes it, the system gathers evidence: the hand-to-mouth gesture,

frases.voz: the sequence of opening the bottle and drinking water, and his usual schedule.
frases.sub: the sequence of opening the bottle and drinking water, and his usual schedule.

frases.voz: No single signal is proof; together, they build confidence.
frases.sub: No single signal is proof; together, they build confidence.

frases.voz: With strong evidence, the dose is confirmed automatically. If in doubt, the watch asks him.
frases.sub: With strong evidence, the dose is confirmed automatically. If in doubt, the watch asks him.

frases.voz: Elsewhere, his daughter Laura gets the confirmation on her phone.
frases.sub: Elsewhere, his daughter Laura gets the confirmation on her phone.

frases.voz: And if a dose has no evidence after thirty minutes, she gets an alert to give him a call.
frases.sub: And if a dose has no evidence after 30 minutes, she gets an alert to give him a call.

frases.voz: So caregivers don't have to keep watch all day.
frases.sub: So caregivers don't have to keep watch all day.

frases.voz: In clinic, you see every dose with its actual time, its delay, how it was confirmed, and with what confidence.
frases.sub: In clinic, you see every dose with its actual time, its delay, how it was confirmed, and with what confidence.

frases.voz: And the patterns: for example, that the evening dose is the one most often missed.
frases.sub: And the patterns: for example, that the evening dose is the one most often missed.

frases.voz: So you can adjust the regimen before increasing the dose.
frases.sub: So you can adjust the regimen before increasing the dose.

frases.voz: Wrist-based pill-taking detection has already been tested in a real-world study, DoseMate, with ninety-four to ninety-five percent balanced accuracy.
frases.sub: Wrist-based pill-taking detection has already been tested in a real-world study, DoseMate, with 94–95% balanced accuracy.

frases.voz: Even so, unconfirmed doesn't mean not taken, and MediTrack is not a medical device: it supports adherence.
frases.sub: Even so, "unconfirmed" doesn't mean "not taken", and MediTrack is not a medical device: it supports adherence.

frases.voz: You can try the prototype online, at christopher argenis dot github dot io, slash MediTrack. Or scan this code.
frases.sub: You can try the prototype online at christopherargenis.github.io/MediTrack. Or scan this code.

frases.voz: We invite you to explore the app and see how MediTrack works. Thank you.
frases.sub: We invite you to explore the app and see how MediTrack works. Thank you.
